subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers rework/adopt the open fork PR for this Feishu reply-mention bug, or close it and queue a narrow replacement fix from this issue?
rationale: The bug is valid, but an open cross-repo PR still targets the exact issue with closing syntax while being conflicting and previously flagged for proof and routing/security concerns, so automation should not create a duplicate fix lane until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Rework or adopt the linked fork PR
options.body: Port the useful fix to current main, address bot-specific mention evidence plus scope-aware routing, and require redacted Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Close the linked PR and queue a replacement
options.body: If the fork branch is not salvageable, close it and then queue a focused replacement PR against the Feishu plugin path.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply behavior
options.body: Keep this issue open without a repair lane until maintainers are ready to revisit Feishu reply semantics.

recommendation.title: Rework or adopt the linked fork PR
recommendation.body: Port the useful fix to current main, address bot-specific mention evidence plus scope-aware routing, and require redacted Feishu proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-path merger and current parser-split history make this the best available routing owner for the maintainer choice.
